complex_text: In accordance with Section 8(1)(j) of the Right to Information Act 2005, the disclosure of information which relates to personal information the disclosure of which has no relationship to any public activity or interest, or which would cause unwarranted invasion of the privacy of the individual is hereby denied.
simple_text: Your request was denied because the law protects personal privacy. Unless there is a large public benefit, private personal details cannot be shared under Section 8(1)(j).
